// diagnostic

E0208

Raw pointer op outside `#Unsafe`: postfix `p.*` deref or prefix `*x` raw-of (D-CAP9)

What

Raw pointer op outside `#Unsafe`: postfix `p.*` deref or prefix `*x` raw-of (D-CAP9)

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0208

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0208: tests/ui/lowlevel_e3101.stderr.

Error [E0208]: taking a raw pointer requires `#Unsafe`
  --> tests/ui/lowlevel_e3101.jet:4:10
    |
  4 |     p :: *Int{*value}
    |          ^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: `*x` takes a raw pointer to `x`; that is a raw memory operation, only valid inside a `#Unsafe { … }` region
 Fix: wrap this in `#Unsafe("why this is safe") { … }` — to dereference a pointer use postfix `p.*`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0208
